name: perf-spawn
js: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(2500);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<4000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log("[perf] perf-spawn "+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+" ms")})()
